execution.title: Audit execution
execution.subtitle: On-site and remote audit workspace
execution.loadError: The audit execution could not be loaded.
execution.notFound: This audit plan was not found.
execution.stepDone: {{step}} is completed. Reopen it to change its data.
execution.readyToComplete: All gates are met. You can complete this step.

stepHints.preparation: Confirm the plan, the agreement and the team, review the client documents and assign the checklists.
stepHints.opening: Confirm the agenda and confidentiality, test the remote tools and record who attended.
stepHints.conduct: Fill the checklists with results and evidence, take photos and raise findings.
stepHints.teamReview: Record the daily wrap-ups and agree the grading of the findings.
stepHints.closing: Present the findings, record the client's position, the response deadline and the signatures.
stepHints.report: The stage report is generated from the audit, reviewed, approved and issued to the client.

start.title: Start the audit execution
start.description: The workspace guides the team through six steps, from preparation to the report.
start.point1: Checklists are generated from the plan's standards and audit stage.
start.point2: Completing the opening meeting starts the audit and opens its report.
start.point3: Results can be recorded offline on a phone and are synchronised later.

blockers.title: To complete this step
blockers.planNotSent: Send the audit plan to the client first.
blockers.teamNotDeclared: The audit team must confirm availability and declare no conflicts on the audit plan.
blockers.documentsNotReviewed: Confirm that the client documents were reviewed.
blockers.checklistsUnassigned: Assign an auditor to every checklist.
blockers.agendaNotConfirmed: Confirm the agenda with the client.
blockers.ictTestMissing: Record the ICT test for the remote activities (IAF MD 4).
blockers.noClientSignature: At least one client attendee must sign the attendance.
blockers.noTeamAttendee: Add the audit team to the attendance.
blockers.mandatoryItemsOpen: Mandatory checklist items without a result: {{count}}
blockers.noWrapUp: Record at least one team wrap-up.
blockers.noConsensus: Confirm the team agreed the grading of the findings.
blockers.findingsNotPresented: Confirm the findings were presented to the client.
blockers.noClientPosition: Record whether the client agrees with the findings.
blockers.noClosingSignature: At least one client attendee must sign the closing meeting attendance.
blockers.ncDueDateMissing: Set the date by which the client must answer the nonconformities.
blockers.noTimeRecorded: Record the time spent by the audit team.
blockers.timeDeviationUnjustified: The time spent is below the planned audit time: record the justification (IAF MD 5).
blockers.noReport: The audit report opens with the opening meeting.
blockers.reportNotIssued: Review, approve and issue the stage report.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.body: Results you record are kept on this device and sent when the connection is back. Waiting: {{count}}
offline.pendingBody: The connection is back. Send the saved changes now.
offline.syncedWithSkipped: Synchronised. Changes skipped because a newer one was saved: {{count}}
offline.needsConnection: This action needs a connection. Try again when you are online.
offline.photoNeedsConnection: Photos are uploaded when you are online.

preparation.readinessDescription: What must be in place before the audit starts.
preparation.planSent: Audit plan sent to the client
preparation.planSentNo: The plan is still a draft.
preparation.clientConfirmedYes: The client confirmed the dates and the team.
preparation.teamDeclaredYes: Availability confirmed and no conflicts declared.
preparation.teamDeclaredNo: Complete the declarations on the audit plan.
preparation.agreementNotRequired: Not required for this audit type.
preparation.agreementMissingBlock: No active agreement: the plan cannot be sent until the client signs it.
preparation.agreementMissingWarn: No active agreement yet: the CAB allows the audit with a warning.
preparation.agreementUnavailable: The agreement status could not be read.
preparation.documentsReviewedHint: Manual, procedures, previous reports and the internal audit and management review records.
preparation.checklistsDescription: Generated from the plan's standards and stage. Assign each checklist to an auditor.
preparation.noChecklists: No checklist yet. Add one from the library.
preparation.chooseChecklist: Choose from the library or your checklists

attendance.description: Each attendee signs on this device: draw, type or upload the signature.
attendance.name: Name
attendance.signatureHint: Optional now: the attendee can also sign later.

opening.title: Opening meeting
opening.description: Introduce the team, confirm the plan, the scope and the rules of the audit.
opening.agendaConfirmedHint: Times, interviewees and guides are agreed.
opening.confidentialityHint: The client was told how information obtained during the audit is protected.
opening.ictTest: ICT test done for the remote activities
opening.ictTestHint: Connection, screen sharing and recording rules checked on {{platform}} (IAF MD 4).
opening.noAgenda: The plan has no agenda yet.

conduct.timelineDescription: Who audits what and when, from the audit plan.
conduct.checklistsDescription: Record a result for each requirement with the evidence seen. Changes save as you go.
conduct.lockedHint: Results are locked after the closing meeting.
conduct.notesPlaceholder: What you saw, heard and read
conduct.reportNotOpen: The audit report opens when the opening meeting is completed.

time.title: Time spent
time.description: Record the team's time each day. It is compared with the planned audit days (IAF MD 5) and added to the competence audit log.

teamReview.findingsDescription: Findings of the audit report. Edit or submit them in the reporting workspace.
teamReview.wrapUpsDescription: What the team agreed at the end of each audit day.
teamReview.consensus: The team agrees on the grading of every finding
teamReview.consensusHint: Major, minor, observation or opportunity, per the scheme rules.

closing.title: Closing meeting
closing.description: Present the findings and the conclusions, agree the next steps and the response deadline.
closing.findingsPresentedHint: Each finding, its grading and the evidence were explained.
closing.clientCommentsHint: Record any disagreement and how it was resolved or left open.
closing.timeDescription: Time delivered against the planned audit days (IAF MD 5).
closing.deviationNoteHint: Why less time was needed, kept with the audit record.

reportStep.title: Stage report
reportStep.description: Generated from the plan, the checklist results and the findings.
reportStep.noReport: The report opens when the opening meeting is completed.

audit_report_issued.title: Audit report {{ref}} issued
audit_report_issued.body: Read the {{stage}} report and acknowledge receipt in the portal.

audit_report_acknowledged.title: Report {{ref}} acknowledged
audit_report_acknowledged.body: {{client}} acknowledged receipt of the audit report.

checklists.title: Checklists
checklists.subtitle: Audit checklists per standard
checklists.draftBadge: Draft for the product owner's review
checklists.draftTitle: Draft for the product owner's review
checklists.draftBody: The iCASCO library summarises each requirement in our own words with its clause number; it is not the text of the standard. Check it against the edition in your accreditation scope, then copy and adapt it.
checklists.emptyCab: No checklist of your own yet. Copy one from the library or create one.
checklists.defaultSet: This checklist is now used when audits of its standard start.
checklists.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}}? Audits keep their own copy.
checklists.name: Name
checklists.standardCodeHint: Example: ISO_9001. Audits of this standard can use the checklist.
checklists.ownWords: Summarise in your own words; do not copy the text of the standard.
checklists.mandatoryLabel: Must be audited at each applicable stage
checklists.newHint: For a scheme the library does not cover, or start from a copy of a library checklist.

report.title: Stage report
report.loadError: The stage report could not be loaded.

workflowHint.notSubmitted: Complete the narrative and the recommendation, then submit the report for technical review.
workflowHint.inReview: A reviewer who was not part of the audit team approves the report or returns it with comments.
workflowHint.changesRequested: The reviewer returned the report. Address the comments and submit it again.
workflowHint.approved: Approved. Issue the report to the client: the version is finalized and the client is notified.
workflowHint.issued: Issued to the client. Waiting for the client's acknowledgement in the portal.
workflowHint.acknowledged: The client acknowledged receipt of the report.

report.blockersTitle: Before the report can go to review
report.reviewHint: Check the report against the evidence and the requirements. The reviewer must not be a member of the audit team.
report.returned: Report returned to the audit team.
report.awaitingAcknowledgement: The client has not acknowledged the report yet.
report.typeHint: Follows the audit stage; change it for a transfer review or a special or short-notice audit.
report.narrativeHint: Sections required by ISO/IEC 17021-1 9.4.8. Suggestions are generated from the audit data.

sections.significantIssues: Significant issues affecting the audit programme
sections.effectiveness: Conformity and effectiveness of the management system
sections.marksUse: Use of certification documents and marks
sections.stage1Concerns: Concerns that could be nonconformities at Stage 2

sectionHints.objectives: What the audit set out to confirm.
sectionHints.criteria: Standards and other documents audited against.
sectionHints.deviations: Changes of dates, sites, time or scope compared with the plan.
sectionHints.significantIssues: Issues that change the audit programme or the certification.
sectionHints.effectiveness: A conclusion on how well the system works, based on the evidence.
sectionHints.objectivesAchieved: Say whether the audit objectives were met, and why not if not.
sectionHints.unresolvedIssues: Disagreements or open questions left at the closing meeting.
sectionHints.internalAuditReliance: How far the internal audits could be relied on.
sectionHints.managementReviewReliance: How far the management review could be relied on.
sectionHints.marksUse: Whether certificates and marks are used correctly.
sectionHints.stage1Readiness: Ready, ready with concerns, or not ready, and the interval to Stage 2.
sectionHints.stage1Concerns: Communicated to the client at the end of Stage 1.
sectionHints.transferReview: Validity of the certificate, open nonconformities and previous reports reviewed.
sectionHints.changes: Changes since the last audit and how they were handled.
sectionHints.complaints: Complaints received and how they were dealt with.

report.autoHint: Filled automatically from the audit execution and the findings.
report.recommendationHint: The audit team's recommendation; the certification decision is taken separately.

outcomes.proceedWithConcerns: Proceed to Stage 2 after the concerns are addressed

report.recommendationNote: Recorded with the report; it is not a certification decision.
report.recommendationFrozen: This version is finalized: open a new draft version in the reporting workspace to change it.

portal.title: Audit progress
portal.subtitle: Schedule, meetings and findings of your audit
portal.loadError: This audit could not be loaded.
portal.progressDescription: Follow your audit step by step, answer findings and acknowledge issued reports.
portal.presentedTitle: Findings presented at the closing meeting
portal.presentedDescription: Nonconformities become formal requests for corrective action when the report is issued.
portal.answerDescription: Send the correction, root cause and corrective action for each nonconformity.
portal.noFindingsToAnswer: Nothing to answer at the moment.
portal.noReport: The report is shared here once it is issued.
portal.acknowledgeHint: Confirm that you received and read the report. Acknowledging does not mean you agree with every finding.
portal.acknowledged: Thank you. The certification body has been notified.
portal.recommendationNote: The certification decision is taken separately by the certification body.
